note: Model presets for VECTOR (docs/CONTRACTS.md section 8a). NO SECRETS IN THIS FILE: each preset names the server environment variable that holds its key (key_env). Free-tier terms and limits change; check each preset's source URLs and edit this file (or point VECTOR_MODEL_PRESETS at a copy) when they do. Limits are enforced locally before any call. Researched 2026-10-09.

presets.label: Ollama (local, native API)
presets.trains_on_prompts_note: Ollama FAQ: Ollama runs locally and does not see prompts or data when you run locally. Cloud-hosted Ollama models (names ending in cloud) leave the machine and are refused by this preset.

qwen3:8b.note: upper bound: the Qwen3 release post date (no cutoff is published)

presets.trains_on_prompts_note: LM Studio docs: it can operate entirely offline; local server requests use OpenAI-style endpoints but stay local.

presets.label: Groq (free plan, OpenAI-compatible)
presets.trains_on_prompts_note: Groq's 'Your Data in GroqCloud' page covers retention (none by default; up to 30 days of logs for reliability/abuse unless Zero Data Retention is enabled) but does not state whether inputs are used for training. Not verified from the binding agreement, so: unknown.

openai/gpt-oss-20b.note: OpenAI lists a knowledge cutoff of 2024-06-01; month-end used as the upper bound

openai/gpt-oss-120b.note: same gpt-oss family cutoff; month-end upper bound

limits.source: https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits (gpt-oss rows: 30 RPM, 1K RPD; the page shows Developer-plan rows and points free accounts to their own limits page, so these are upper bounds - lower them to your account's values)

presets.label: OpenRouter (:free models only)
presets.trains_on_prompts_note: OpenRouter routes to third-party providers whose training policies differ; free and paid models have separate training settings, and opting out stops routing to providers that train. Depends on your account setting and the routed provider: unknown.

openai/gpt-oss-20b:free.note: OpenAI lists a knowledge cutoff of 2024-06-01; month-end used as the upper bound

limits.source: https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/limits (:free variants: 20 RPM; 50 requests/day with under 10 credits purchased, 1000/day with 10 or more)

presets.label: Google Gemini Flash (free tier, OpenAI-compatible endpoint)
presets.trains_on_prompts_note: Gemini API Additional Terms (updated 2026-04-28): for Unpaid Services Google uses submitted content and responses to provide, improve and develop Google products, and human reviewers may read API input and output. The pricing page marks free-tier content 'used to improve our products'.

limits.source: conservative local caps: Google publishes free-tier per-model limits only in AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/rate-limit); set these to your account's values
